steps: Noya is wounded by sniper fire, and your worried allies rush in to help. No. 160 reveals her abnormal power, crushing their morale. For their safety, you choose a temporary truce and agree to negotiate with Angie.
Ugh, what's going on?==W== My waist feels warm...==W==
Where are the snipers at?! Can't see through this thick sand!
Don't move! You're hit. I'll stop the bleeding.
Well, well. Took a hit to the flank and still managed to play hero.==W== Fast reflexes, or just dumb luck?
Not that it matters. Your time is up.==W== Piercer locks onto a marked and no one escapes it. You're up next, blond Trekker.
No lethal shots, Gunhild. No permanent damage, either. Just take them out of the fight.
The Committee is here to kill the Tyrant and save this world.==W== We strike at the root. There is no need to butcher the Trekkers who were brainwashed into following ==SEX4==.
Ma'am, you sure know how to test a girl...==W== Sniping moving targets from this far out, and holding back the damage?
It is a tall order. But you can handle it, can't you?
Hah! Obviously. I'm the best gunner in Sentinel of Dawn. Make that the best in all of Nova! Since the blond Trekker's hit, time to switch target!
(That last shot came from wide open terrain...==W== There's zero cover out there...!==W== I have to keep moving and make myself the bait.)
Aww, look at you go, girl with black hair. Too bad you're a whole five kilometers away.
Piercer is the only weapon in Nova that can hit from this distance. You don't even know where to look.
Let's just clip that shoulder. No more guns for you.
A counter-snipe?! No way! Those dinky White Cat rifles don't have this kind of range!
On the dunes behind us!? Dang it, when did she slip past?!==W== And the three Trekkers are gone too! They must have used the distraction to slip into the house!
Sentinel kid, finding the safest cover is more important than aiming when it comes to sniping. Your inexperience is showing.
Oops, I guess everyone knows my true colors now,==W== and it's all on you, Boss.==W== You'll hear from me once this is over, hehe.
Take cover! It's just one shooter! Third Company, search, spread out and flush them out! Secure the artillery!
I intercepted a secret letter. Please take a look.
Stop right there. What's your company? I don't recognize you.
Tsk. Busted.==W== Guess I'll just let my bat do the talking!
Ugh! She hits hard!==W== Let me guess, another Trekker brainwashed by the Tyrant?==W== Did you seriously think you could waltz in here and attack us without any consequences?
Your precious Boss sent you here to die! You're just a pawn!
A pawn? Hah! Are you hearing yourself? What do you know about honor?==W== I back Boss because I want to. Nobody gives me orders.
Save the lecture for when you're eating dirt.==W==
(She's too close, I can't fire!==W== How the hell does a bat hit harder than my Piercer?!)
(I can't hold her off... Crap. I've got to get Director Angie clear!)
(Otoha's disguises are insane. I walked right into their lair.==W== Just gotta crush this sniper, grab the commander, and we're golden!)
(My sleeve... What just tore through it? I didn't sense any magic at all...)
The honors student from Platinum Academy, and the leader of the Ashwind Clan.==W== The streets under the Emor Waterway are only at peace because of you.
This is a Scepter of Death, wished into existence by your Boss, the very Tyrant we are hunting.
Leave while you still can.==W== You're a good person. We might be enemies right now, but I really don't want to kill you.
(The guards Otoha lured away are back. And that Scepter is bad news. Time to bail.)
You really think you grunts can box me in?!
(Dammit. I usually swat these tin cans like flies, but they're rock solid in formation.)
Miss Minova! Help's coming your way.
Take this! Smoke...==W== Ahhh, how do you steer this scooter?!==W==
Ma'am. Minova and that Trekker from Petal Bloom vanished in the smoke. Should we go after them?
A bird?==W== No... That's a witch!
Mistique, from Scarlet Sights Media. Another ally to the Tyrant. Bound by her duties as a witch, she won't engage directly, but she is watching every move we make.
Just give the word and I'll shoot her out of the sky!
No. The Dusk Arbiter has already branded us heretics.==W== If we strictly target the Tyrant, we can prove our true intent is saving the world. That is how we clear our names.
But if we gun down a witch from the press, we validate every lie told about us. And if the entire world turns against the Salvation Committee, who will be left to protect Nova?
Ugh, what a headache. Why doesn't anyone get it?==W== Look at what happened to the Monoliths.==W== How is everyone so blind?!
Because Grace Imperium censored the news,==W== and because people are fragile. Burying their heads in the sand is the only way they know how to live.
You have one hour. Secure this artillery position, then we proceed as planned.
I'm heading to Daisy Orphanage.==W== I need to see the Tyrant one last time.
Boss, that building up ahead is Daisy Orphanage, right?
Yeah.==W== I just hope Noya's team is holding up. Seven people against an entire squad of Sentinels and Knights is a massive gamble.
Boss... I really should have stayed behind to help them.
No, Iris made the right call.==W== The kids come first.==W== With all this chaos outside, they must be terrified. You are the only one who can calm them down.
You're right. I'll trust you.==W== Sigh... Leaving my own kids behind to fight. I am such a failure of a mother.
Blame yourselves for siding with the Tyrant who is going to end this world.
Master, someone is blocking the path ahead.
That is the Arbiter from earlier. But why is she alone?
Hello there!==W== I am Arbiter No. 160 of the Dusk Arbiter.==W== I also command a company with the Salvation Committee.
Your friends are incredibly tough. They completely pinned down my subordinates.==W== Which means the job of capturing the Tyrant falls entirely on my shoulders.
So... Little girls with white and green hair, and lady with pink... Mind stepping aside? I just want to sever the tendons in the Tyrant's limbs.
Do not worry. I only want the Tyrant. I absolutely, positively will not leave a single scratch on any of you.
I-I will not let you touch Master!==W==
I-I'm sorry. ==W==I-I am so sorry! Are you okay? I thought you would dodge! It should be easy to dodge that!
She's so weak.==W== There's no need to apologize, Fuyuka. She brought this on herself. Let's go.
Brought it on myself...==W== Hehehe... You are absolutely right! I totally did!==W== The feeling of my organs rupturing... Ugh!==W== It hurts so much, but I absolutely love it!
Please! Give me more pain! More fear!

Gasp... A crossbow bolt tearing through skin... Flesh getting pierced...==W== Little white-haired girl, keep punching my stomach! That heavy thud against my guts is the absolute best feeling in the world!
Hehe, this pain is familiar...==W== Oh, I think ... I am almost there!
E-Ew!==W== Fuyuka, let's just knock her out!
Nazuna, Fuyuka, stay back! Something is wrong. She is giving off a massive aura of magic!==W==
It hurts... It hurts so bad... The feeling is here!
_NOT_IN_LOG_==Off== It hurts, it hurts, it hurts, it hurts, it hurts! I am scared, I am scared, I am scared!
I am sorry, it is all my fault! I will do anything, just please stop hitting me!
Oh God of Grace, if you truly exist...
Please stop the clock! Make it stop!
This is ... paralysis spell? No... Even the dust in the air is frozen completely still.
Did she just ... stop time? That is impossible!
Oh?==W== You can actually move inside my Pause.==W== Lady Angie was right. You have a very special constitution. Magic really does not work on you.
Your subordinates aren't so lucky, though.==W== I am going to show them that sometimes, death is an absolute luxury.
Nazuna? Fuyuka? Allie? What's wrong? Are you alright?
Sobbing... What do I do... Master... Master, say something!
It is my fault... I.. I lost control again. I hit you!
Fuyuka, what are you talking about?==W== I am right here!
These hands... They ruin everything. I-I should cut them off. If I cut them off, I can't hurt anyone ever again.
Nazuna... Help me. Please, chop off my hands!
Nazuna, grab her! She is under a spell!
If I hadn't lost my temper, Boss and Nazuka wouldn't have gone after those monsters alone. They wouldn't have disappeared.
I wish I didn't have this stupid mouth.
Right, I should shoot myself in it .
Hehehe... Hahahaha!==W== You can't wake them up, Tyrant.
They are infected with my Scars.==W== They are trapped in their absolute worst nightmares... Completely helpless.==W== They can do nothing but cry and hurt themselves.
Fear is the sweetest poison. You just drown in it.==W== Someone as blindly happy as you could never understand, Tyrant.
Anyway, time to drag you back to Lady Angie.==W== I wonder if this prize is enough for her to pierce my body with a Scepter of Death.
Kids...? Why aren't you saying anything?
Oh? The pink-haired lady can still stand? Hehe, guess the Scars I gave you weren't deep enough. Let's add one more.
I see... You are the one who murdered my kids.
What... How are you fighting back?! No one escapes my web of fear!
I understand now, I do. It is because I failed to protect them. I am a terrible mother who does not deserve to live.
Yes! Exactly! Hate yourself! Go on, end your own life! Lady Angie forbade me from killing you, but if you kill yourself, she can't blame me.
I absolutely should die. But not before I do this one thing.
How dare you do this to my kids… I'll grind every last one of you to dust!
My kids… It was this hand that hurt them, wasn't it?
Do you know? If you grip the hand and arm, then twist the bones like wringing out a towel…
A lot of vivid "paint" comes pouring out...
Is that all you can take?
God of Grace, please stop the...
Trying to say your last words? Apologies, but I have zero interest in hearing my kids' murderer talk.
I will just crush your throat instead.
Forgive the intrusion, Director Allie. But I cannot stand by and let you kill my subordinate. I don't want to see you drown in this madness either.
Lady Angie... I-I am sorry. I couldn't catch the Tyrant.
Sleep, No. 160. You did your job.
Master...?==W== Wait, what was I doing?
Boss...? You are right here. Wh-Why was I in such pain just now?==W== Ugh, my head! Why was I thinking those thoughts?!
No. 160 passed out. The spell is broken.
My kids, I've let you down...
That state... It was exactly like that erased future I saw in the White Room.
No. 160 must have made her hallucinate the kids dying. But she severely underestimated what a vengeful mother is capable of.
Serena senpai... No, it should be Angie now... Petal Bloom and I may be in your debt,==W== but I-I'll die before I let you lay a finger on Master!
We're now enemies on a battlefield. Let's test it. Your Scepter of Death against my crossbow.
Heh. Chill. Tyrant, your allies are impressive. They survived a direct ambush from the Salvation Committee and even mounted a counterattack.
I truly do not want to hurt them. Saving this world does require all the strength we can muster.
If you accept, the Salvation Committee will call a truce before we negotiate.
A truce... Fuyuka, Nazuna, and Allie have just barely survived No. 160's magic.
Noya's status is unclear, and we need to buy time to move the Daisy Orphanage's kids. In that case...
Hehe. I knew you'd make the right choice.
You have two hours. I will be waiting here, Tyrant.
